nft_issuance.issuer_policy: Recommend dedicated NFT issuer distinct from fungible token issuer

creative_rules: One highly detailed cinematic 3D MENACE character is the focal point
One restrained street-art or optical-illusion background motif per NFT
Extensive zoomable detail with historically validated XRPL lore
Avoid busy collages and multiple artist influences in one background
Each character must be unique and compositionally coherent
Do not reproduce an artist's protected artwork or signature without permission
Use high-resolution source art and a final microdetail verification pass

production.lore_review: verify all XRPL historic claims, exact dates and references before encoding
production.metadata_review: validate image and attributes, CID, and immutable settings before mint
